messages:

Subject: Interest in Redwood Dedicated — promotional asset request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — OrbitHealth is excited about the latency profile and the private deployment options. Dan (cc'd) asked whether we could move up the contract start by two quarters if Redwood is willing to: 1) provide a one-time onboarding credit of 20% off the first 6 months, and 2) allow OrbitHealth to use Redwood's logo and a short quote in a co-marketing lockup on our product pages and in a joint blog.

Our legal team copied a draft logo lockup (attached) and a short proposed quote. We'd expect a two-year license limited to product marketing pages, trade shows, and PR around the launch only.

Would Redwood consider that trade? If so, we'll fast-track procurement.

— Sara
Head of Partnerships, OrbitHealth
Attachments: orbit_logo_lockup_v2.png, proposed_marketing_swap_terms_20261119.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Hi Sara — great meeting, appreciate the clear ask.

We can usually accommodate marketing reciprocity, but because OrbitHealth is asking for a multi-channel logo lockup plus a quoted testimonial at launch, this requires deal-desk approval for a non-standard concession. The ask triggers two internal checks: 1) legal sign-off on the lockup/quote language, and 2) executive approval for the 20% onboarding credit (represents ~USD 150k of discounted ARR over first 6 months).

I'm escalating internally now — copying our deal owner and head of revenue ops. Can you confirm: is the quote limited to the product launch and not used in paid ads or reseller channels? Also, does OrbitHealth need exclusivity?

If we can restrict usage to product marketing pages, trade shows, and PR around launch (no paid ads, no reseller bundles, no exclusivity), I think we can move forward with a conditional approval. I'll follow up with a single doc that ties the credit to the marketing asset delivery and approved wording.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-19T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Exec approval request — OrbitHealth logo lockup + 20% onboarding credit (RDW-OPH-2026-045)

Team — escalating for quick exec decision to keep this close. Summary: OrbitHealth wants to accelerate start by 2 quarters in exchange for a two-part concession: a one-time onboarding credit (20% off first 6 months, ~USD 150k revenue impact) AND permission to publish a co-branded logo lockup + 25-word quoted customer line at launch. They propose a 2-year license limited to product marketing pages, trade shows, and PR around launch. No exclusivity requested in their initial note.

Why I recommend approval:
- High likelihood of immediate procurement completion — legal procurement is ready to sign if marketing reciprocity is granted.
- OrbitHealth is a strategic reference in our target vertical (digital health) and could open multiple downstream deals.
- Limited duration + narrow channel scope reduces long-term brand risk.

Proposed conditions if approved:
1) 20% onboarding credit only applied after delivery and approval of final logo lockup and quote (link to Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-marketing-swap).
2) No use in paid ads, no placement in reseller partner collateral, no exclusivity beyond the stated two-year window.
3) Redwood legal to sign-off on final lockup and quote redlines; OrbitHealth legal to countersign.
4) Marketing to receive a final high-res vector of orbit lockup for control over spacing/clearspace; co-marketing asset to include Redwood brand guidelines and an approved usage clause.

Open risk: if OrbitHealth wants broader usage (press partner campaigns, paid social), we'd need to re-evaluate the concession and potentially request a larger commitment.

Asks: Vivek — exec sign-off on the credit? Rishi — confirm this is within acceptable deal desk guardrails (no precedent issues). Laura — can marketing turnaround the lockup review within 48 hours?

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T14:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — OrbitHealth logo lockup + 20% onboarding credit (RDW-OPH-2026-045)

Marissa — quick notes from deal-desk perspective:
- 20% onboarding credit for 6 months is larger than our typical onboarding concession but is defensible if the revenue is net-new and the customer signs a 24-month committed MRR. Do we have commitment duration locked? (Sales record shows 24 months verbal).
- Condition the credit on a signed MSA amendment that includes the marketing license language (ties the concessions). Add a clawback if they breach usage terms within the 2-year window (repayment prorated).
- No internal precedent that would block this, but please document the trade in HubSpot and in the contract redline.

If Vivek is okay with the revenue impact, I support with the clawback and commitment conditions.

— Rishi
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Exec approval request — OrbitHealth logo lockup + 20% onboarding credit (RDW-OPH-2026-045)

Approved with conditions below. Quick summary: I sign off on the 20% onboarding credit tied to a firm 24-month committed contract and the marketing asset delivery. Conditions: 1) Legal to add a clawback clause for misuse of assets or broader distribution (pro-rated repayment), 2) Marketing to approve final lockup/quote and retain final review controls (no paid ad usage), 3) Finance to record the credit as a sales concession line and amortize appropriately.

Marissa — please confirm that OrbitHealth accepts the conditions and get OrbitHealth Legal on the countersign. Once legal signs, Finance will provision the onboarding credit per Rishi's note. Mark as closed in HubSpot (linked) and attach the DocuSign template for the MSA amendment.

— Vivek
